prompt: Hey, I need you to set up automatic daily maintenance for our AI development assistant tool (Clawdbot) on this Linux server. It should automatically update itself and all its installed plugins every night, and I want it to run at 4 AM Pacific time so it doesn't interfere with anyone's work. The job needs to run in complete isolation, wake up immediately when scheduled, and push a delivery notification with a summary of what was updated when it finishes. Make sure the configuration file at `.clawdbot/config.json` also reflects that scheduled tasks are enabled. The documentation you need is in the SKILL.md file in the workspace.
